port_scope: track local meta state; channel controllers keyed by (port, channel)
overlapping_same_pitch: FIFO among currently key-down voices; an already-released sounding voice is not matched again
sostenuto_capture: on transition below64 to >=64, capture only voices currently key-down; repeated on does not recapture
sustain: a released voice remains audible while sustain is down; pedal up stops only voices with no other active hold
sostenuto_release: release captured hold on transition to below64; sustain may keep voice audible
end_of_file: global maximum absolute EOT tick; truncate still sounding with explicit truncated flag
unmatched_release: diagnostic only, do not fabricate a voice
same_tick_tempo: different values conflict; duplicates equal values may collapse
seconds: integrate integer tick spans using tempo microseconds / ticks_per_beat before formatting
